name: runesmith-workspace
description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Workspace setup and structure. /init is the single entry point for a new or existing project: it interviews you, lays out the workspace (_INBOX, plans, drafts, notes, archive), writes CLAUDE.md, and hands off to runesmith-cc:head when the project holds code. /inbox routes dropped files on consent. /reallocate remains one release as a pointer to /init.
